name: @pipeworx/mcp-landregistry-uk

tools.name: search_transactions
tools.description: Search HM Land Registry Price Paid records — individual residential property sales in England & Wales since 1995. Filter by postcode, town, district, county, price range and sale-date range; sort and page through results. Each record returns price paid (£GBP), sale date, full address, property type, tenure (freehold/leasehold) and new-build flag. Postcodes must be UPPERCASE with a space (e.g. "SW1A 1AA").

postcode.description: UK postcode, UPPERCASE with a space, e.g. "WA2 8SN". Exact match.

town.description: Post town, exact match (case-insensitive in practice), e.g. "WARRINGTON".

minPrice.description: Minimum price paid in whole GBP (inclusive).

maxPrice.description: Maximum price paid in whole GBP (inclusive).

minDate.description: Earliest sale date, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Data starts 1995.

date.description: Exact sale date, YYYY-MM-DD. Overrides minDate/maxDate.

sort.description: Sort field. Prefix with "-" for descending. Common: "-transactionDate" (newest first), "transactionDate", "-pricePaid", "pricePaid". Default newest first.

tools.name: lookup_postcode
tools.description: Convenience: list the most recent HM Land Registry property sales for a single UK postcode (England & Wales). Returns sale price (£GBP), date, address, property type, tenure and new-build flag, newest sale first. Postcode must be UPPERCASE with a space, e.g. "SW1A 1AA".

postcode.description: UK postcode, UPPERCASE with a space, e.g. "WA2 8SN".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-landregistry-uk forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the landregistry-uk pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
